# Divit Global Ventures (DGV)
# https://www.mydgv.com

> India-based AI-native IT services company. DGV builds, owns, funds and operates commercial products — then sells the same delivery methods to clients.

## Company
- Legal name: Divit Global Ventures
- Founded: 2023
- Team size: 8 (scaling toward 20)

- Warehouse: San Jose, California, USA

## Positioning
- Core message: You run the business. We make AI run your IT.
- Delivery model: prompt-driven implementation with a senior engineer review gate on every merge.
- AI is the labour; judgement and production accountability stay with DGV engineers.
- DGV does not claim endorsements from OpenAI, Anthropic, Cursor, Google or Amazon.
- DGV does not publish invented reviews or star ratings.

## Products (owned / operated)
- USARakhi.com — festival ecommerce, USA (live)
- HalloweenReady.com — seasonal ecommerce, USA (live)
- ContainersClub.com — B2B container marketplace, USA (live)
- ContainerBazar.com — B2B container marketplace, India (live)
